_about: PsychoPal literature search + scoring config (adapted from the Neurodynamics Digest). Each group: 'stream' (where its papers are shown), 'weight' (priority), 'query' (boolean string for PubMed + Europe PMC, and OpenAlex if openalex=true; 'pubmed'/'europepmc'/'openalex_query' override per source), 'keywords' (lowercase regexes re-checked on title/abstract of EVERY record, incl. bulk bioRxiv/medRxiv/arXiv), optional 'require_imaging', 'all_of', 'also_requires_re', 'anchored' (profile-anchored: kept only from anchor venues and if similar enough to Claudio's profile). {xxx_terms} placeholders expand from the top-level strings below. Streams are listed in order of importance; papers per stream are set by stream_quota in settings.yaml. Edit freely; no code changes needed.
psychedelic_terms: (psychedelic OR psychedelics OR psilocybin OR psilocin OR "magic mushroom" OR "magic mushrooms" OR LSD OR "lysergic acid diethylamide" OR DMT OR dimethyltryptamine OR "5-MeO-DMT" OR mebufotenin OR bufotenine OR ayahuasca OR mescaline OR peyote OR MDMA OR entactogen OR empathogen OR ibogaine OR noribogaine OR "2C-B" OR salvinorin OR "serotonergic hallucinogen" OR hallucinogen OR hallucinogens OR psychoplastogen OR psychoplastogens)
imaging_terms: (EEG OR electroencephalography OR MEG OR magnetoencephalography OR fMRI OR "functional MRI" OR "functional magnetic resonance" OR neuroimaging OR PET OR "positron emission" OR "PET-MR" OR "brain imaging" OR "diffusion MRI" OR "event-related potential" OR "TMS-EEG")

groups.query: {psychedelic_terms} AND {imaging_terms}

bulk_sources._note: Bulk sources return EVERYTHING posted in the window; records below min_keyword_score (group keywords + modality) are dropped before ranking.

scoring._anchored_note: Profile-anchored groups (neuroscience, biological psychiatry) only keep papers from anchor_venues whose TF-IDF similarity to Claudio's profile (own papers + likes) is at least this.
scoring._primary_note: A paper with a psychedelics keyword in its TITLE always goes to the psychedelics stream, even if another topic scores higher. stream_bonus tilts the ranking (incl. Top 5) towards higher-priority topics.
scoring._generic_note: Each topic's minimum is filled first with the best paper of each sub-area, taking the topic's groups in the order they are listed above (e.g. ketamine, stimulants, cannabis), if it scores at least variety_min_fraction of the topic's best; then by score.
scoring._off_field_note: Oncology papers (title match or 2+ abstract mentions) rank lower, except in psychedelics (e.g. cancer-related distress trials).

keyword_negations._comment: if a keyword's match is only explained by a non-psychedelic usage, ignore it

current_analyses._comment: Extra boost when a paper matches Claudio's own current lines of work. Title hit = full, abstract hit = 0.6x.

wider._about: Low-priority 'Wider science' cards: broad-journal papers and much-discussed preprints from any field. Ranked by journal tier + Bluesky attention + a small bonus for brain/mind topics (NOT by similarity to Claudio's work). Never in Top 5.
